title: Mishy Mishy Smash
style: Jazz swing big band, 1970s swagger, medium-up swing with walking bass, punchy brass stabs, brushed drums, and a playful call-and-response chorus; verse rides upright bass and sparse comping, pre-chorus lifts with trombone swells and rimshot snaps, chorus hits with full horn riff, stacked gang vocals, and short delay throws on the hook word. Close-mic lead vocal with bright doubles, shouted ad-libs, trumpet fills between lines, tape hiss, and a roomy club mix with warm analog punch., swing, jazz, big band
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Michelle, come here now
Mishy got clipped hard
By the back truck wheel
Right leg, that's the card

Can't run like I did
But I can still walk
Ice on the knee, baby
Still got my spark

[Pre-Chorus]
Tennis shoes in a box
Swapped for something new
Bend that elbow low
I got one shot through

Hear that crowd lean in
Feel that old-school heat
One bad step ain't done
I still got my beat

[Chorus]
Michelle mishy mish mash
Pickle ball smash
Michelle mishy mish mash
Pickle ball smash

Got my right leg bad
But I still show up
Tennis pro to pickle ball pro!
Pickle ball smash

(mishy mishy smash)
(smash)
(mishy mishy smash)
(smash)

[Verse 2]
Used to serve so clean
Cross-court, corner line
Now I play smart, baby
Take my time

Big smile on my face
When the paddle flips
I can't chase every ball
But I still make hits

Laugh at the hard luck
Spit it out and dance
One more clean return
Give me one more chance

[Pre-Chorus]
Tap the floor, feel steady
Count it out with me
Pain can't call the shots
Not tonight, not me

Toss that worry aside
Let the whole room see
I may move a little slow
Still got style and speed

[Chorus]
Michelle mishy mish mash
Pickle ball smash
Michelle mishy mish mash
Pickle ball smash

Got my right leg bad
But I still show up
Tennis pro to pickle ball pro!
Pickle ball smash

(mishy mishy smash)
(smash)
(mishy mishy smash)
(smash)

[Bridge]
Back truck hit me down
Tried to take my name
But I learned a new court
And I played that game

Walk it, work it, win it
One step, then another
Michelle by my side
We don't need much more

[Final Chorus]
Michelle mishy mish mash
Pickle ball smash
Michelle mishy mish mash
Pickle ball smash

Got my right leg bad
But I still show up
Tennis pro to pickle ball pro!
Pickle ball smash

Michelle mishy mish mash
Pickle ball smash
(mishy mishy smash)
Pickle ball smash
